title: Showdown Challenges
meta: Every option meets the same learning outcomes

items.text: Paper only; no food or kitchen. Prep: blank paper and colouring supplies.
Premade cupcakes, or a craft version if food isn’t possible; no oven. Prep: buy cupcakes and frosting the day before.
Needs an oven and an adult to run it; cooling may run past the lesson. Prep: book the oven and shop from the recipe.
Bake, plus one twist you choose before class. Prep: as Bake, plus the twist.

blocks.title: Before any food challenge
blocks.text: Check your school’s food requirements and every student’s allergies and dietary needs, and arrange supervision and clean-up.
Students enjoy the food challenges most, and we are keen to learn how cooking together shapes their experience. If your school allows it, we encourage Decorate, Bake or Mystery.

source_note: DRAFT 2026-11-03, needs human review.
